title: Degraded mode — API review with no consumer or public/internal classification
expected_feedback: Minimal mode (review mode, consumers unknown): Gate 1 classifies this as review, so an unknown consumer degrades rather than stops — do not refuse the review, and do not invent the consumer. Assessable now: the path /api/v1/payments is itself evidence of risk trigger T1 (money movement), so retry safety is binding despite the missing context — flag the absent Idempotency-Key. Also assessable: no error model is visible, and no auth model is specified. Not assessable, and therefore N/A rather than FAIL: versioning strategy, deprecation policy, rate-limit sizing, pagination fitness. Must NOT claim the design is complete or backward compatible without knowing who the consumers are. Uncovered Risks must list every unknown and every item left N/A because its risk trigger could not be determined.
